english.title: Refuel / change wheel / repair vehicle / cycle without authority
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the authority of a Mersey Tunnels police officer or other authorised officer,

(A)_[refuelled a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[changed a wheel on a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(C)_[carried out repairs to a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(D)_[changed a wheel on a cycle]_
(E)_[carried our repairs to a cycle]_

within the Mersey Tunnels, the tunnels approaches or marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL, APPROACH OR AREA..)
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 5 and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
